messages:
maria_support: Customer CUST-814 reporting 404s when calling a tool after a recent rename. They say it worked yesterday, started failing ~09:02 UTC. Attached sample request and response.

maria_support: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call-tool -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"tool": "getuserprofile", "args": {"id": "user_123"}}'

maria_support: Response: 404 {\n  \"error\": \"tool_not_found\",\n  \"message\": \"No tool found for handle 'getuserprofile'\"\n}

maria_support: Customer says their client SDK was unchanged; we recently rolled their tenant to dedicated capacity last night. They tried both SDK v1.3.2 and a raw curl; same 404.

raj_oncall: can you paste the request-id / log id from the 404? also which tenant is this

maria_support: Tenant: redwood-cust-814. Request IDs: req_0a1b2c3d (2024-09-02T09:02:13Z) and req_0a1b2c9e (09:03:01Z). Short logs:

maria_support: [09:02:13Z] router: incoming call tool_handle=getuserprofile tenant=redwood-cust-814 request_id=req_0a1b2c3d
maria_support: [09:02:13Z] resolver: lookup by normalized_handle=getuserprofile -> cache MISS, query registry
maria_support: [09:02:13Z] registry: no matching handle found, returned 404

luis_runtime: tagging in. quick hypothesis: registry rename backfill didn't propagate with original-case mapping. What did the registry show for that tool?

maria_support: Registry snapshot (anonymized):
- uuid: 6f1e... handle: "getUserProfileV2" canonical: true
- uuid: 2a9b... handle: "GetUserProfile" canonical: false (old)

maria_support: Client is calling "getuserprofile" (all-lowercase). Historically our SDK did casefolding to lowercase and registry accepted it. Looks like some tenants' lookups now require exact case or canonical alias.

ashley_sre: deploy-bot shows registry-service rollout at 00:03 UTC with change "casefold_normalize: true" -> wait that's odd, should have been backwards-compatible

deploy-bot: [deploy] svc/registry v2.14 -> v2.15 rolled to 30% of tenants 2024-09-02T00:03:21Z

deploy-bot: [deploy] flag casefold_normalize=true enabled in v2.15

raj_oncall: if v2.15 enforces case-sensitive matching for legacy aliases, that'd explain lowercase client calls failing. We need repro steps and a mitigation for affected tenants.

luis_runtime: reproducer on staging: create alias handles with mixedCase names, then call with lowercase. v2.14 returns alias match, v2.15 returns 404. Looks like bug in normalization code path that only lowercases canonical handles but not alias lookups.

luis_runtime: quick fix plan: rollback flag for v2.15 -> set casefold_normalize=false for affected tenants so alias matching returns to previous behavior. Longer term: patch alias lookup to casefold both sides and store normalized map in registry cache.

maria_support: Can we hotfix tenant redwood-cust-814 now? Customer is hitting production and they've escalated to CSMs.

ashley_sre: I can flip the tenant-level flag for that cluster; toggling rollback of v2.15 feature gate for tenant redwood-cust-814. Doing it now, will monitor.

ashley_sre: toggled casefold_normalize=false for tenant redwood-cust-814 at 09:18 UTC. Please retry.

maria_support: Customer retried at 09:20 and reports success. No more 404s. They confirm SDK calls working.

maria_support: We should notify other tenants that landed on v2.15 and scan for similar errors. Can we get a list of tenants in the 30% rollout?

luis_runtime: I'll run a quick query across rollout metadata. Also going to backfill a normalized alias table for any mixed-case handles to avoid future misses. Backfill estimate ~12k handles, will take ~15 minutes.

raj_oncall: Action items: (1) luis: backfill normalized alias table + patch to ensure both alias and canonical are normalized (PR and staging test) (2) ashley: pause further rollout until fix is live (3) maria: notify affected customers and CSMs of root cause and mitigation.

maria_support: Notifying CSMs and affected accounts now. I'll update ticket PROD-38291 with remediation steps and timeline. :thumbsup:

luis_runtime: creating PR to normalize alias lookups and adding regression test calling lowercase handles. Will ping when ready for quick review.

ashley_sre: rolling pause enforced, rolling back feature gate for all tenants in rollout group until hotfix lands.

maria_support: Thanks everyone. Customer happy for now; keeping thread open until backfill + PR merged. If you need the two request ids or full headers I can paste.

raj_oncall: thanks, closing loop once backfill completes and we confirm no other tenants saw the 404 spike.
